top_signals.title: Foreigners Make Record Withdrawal From Taiwan Stocks on AI Rout
top_signals.summary: Foreign outflows from Taiwanese stocks hit a record in October as a global selloff in artificial intelligence play pushed the island’s benchmark closer to a technical correction.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Japan’s Katayama Says Ready to Take Steps for Stable FX Market
top_signals.summary: Japanese authorities are prepared to respond if currency market movements become disorderly, acting in accordance with a standing pact with her US counterpart, Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said, one day before the US holds its midterm elections.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
